research_question: can deployable posture and loaded-interface state predict and rank remaining measured cumulative cuff-force cost beyond an obvious phase/progress/time baseline

value_semantics.quantity: undiscounted remaining integral of the norm of deployable measured physical cuff force
value_semantics.optimization_sign: the fitted quantity is remaining cost C_rem >= 0; a cost-minimizing MPC would use J_short + C_rem. If an API retains J_short - V, it must publish V = -C_rem without changing the target semantics

failure_target.rule: charge the greater of one full phase timeout or the remaining registered active-phase budget at the unchanged engineering force-gate scale
failure_target.interpretation: pessimistic value-target convention only; not a new constraint, clinical threshold, or hardware limit

model.family: standardized linear ridge with auditable engineered deployable features
model.baseline_features: phase one-hot, diagnostic progress, phase elapsed, remaining registered time budget, HOLD remaining
model.candidate_additions: q_hat, dq_hat, q1/q2 posture coordination terms, measured cuff wrench, and estimated interface displacement/velocity/rotation/angular velocity
model.fixed_human_model_context: model version and theta are artifact metadata because they are constant in this isolated study

decision_gates.v_a: adequate trajectory support, candidate beats baseline on held-out trajectories, and matched feasible branch-ranking gates pass
decision_gates.v_b: adequate trajectory support and held-out prediction beats baseline, but matched path-ranking evidence is missing or insufficient
decision_gates.v_c: trajectory support, target/state representation, or held-out prediction is insufficient

control_authority.unsupported_terminal_rule_for_future_ab: if any compared candidate terminal is OOD, disable learned terminal value for the entire solve and use the zero-value incumbent for all candidates
